summary: Harder voted yes on the IHRA codification, $14 billion in Israel weapons, UNRWA cuts, a PLO entry ban, and resolutions condemning pro-Palestine student speech. Endorsements from California Jewish Democrats and DMFI PAC, with Vote for Peace opposing him, anchor his pro-Israel alignment. In 2025–2026 he shifted—no on the 2027 NDAA, yes on the Massie amendment cutting $3.3 billion in aid—but also yes on a 2026 NDAA with $500 million for Israeli missile defense.
